immersivevfx.options.title: ImmersiveVFX
immersivevfx.options.moddedDimensions.em: No modded dimensions known yet. Join a world to list them.
immersivevfx.menu.about.coloredLightInte: How strongly lights tint and brighten what they shine on.
immersivevfx.menu.about.coloredLightRadi: How far the color of a light reaches.
immersivevfx.menu.noneChanged: No settings differ from their defaults.
immersivevfx.menu.offWithIris: Turned off by Use Iris Shaders.
immersivevfx.menu.about.useIrisShaders: When enabling this will turn off all existing shaders such as Shadows, Reflections, Vegetation, Color Grading, Dynamic Color Grading, Atmospheric Fog and other settings. The only remaining effects that are adjustable are Particle Effects.
immersivevfx.menu.page.general.desc: The overall look of the game.
immersivevfx.menu.page.sky.desc: What you see when you look up.
immersivevfx.menu.page.fog.desc: Haze in the distance and mist near the ground.
immersivevfx.menu.page.lighting.desc: Glow, light sources and rays of sunlight.
immersivevfx.menu.page.shadows.desc: Shadows from the sun and the moon.
immersivevfx.menu.page.water.desc: Reflections, the water surface and life below it.
immersivevfx.menu.page.particles.desc: Small things floating through the air.
immersivevfx.menu.page.weather.desc: Weather effects and rare sights in the sky.
immersivevfx.menu.page.outlines.desc: Contours around blocks, mobs and enchanted items.
immersivevfx.menu.page.dimensions.desc: What ImmersiveVFX does in the End and in modded dimensions.
immersivevfx.menu.about.smoothBlockPlace: Blocks grow into place instead of popping in.
immersivevfx.menu.about.torchLight: Torches, lanterns and other glowing blocks in your hand light up the area around you, also from mods. Glowing blocks in your hand really glow.
immersivevfx.menu.about.moddedBiomes: Gives biomes from other mods fitting fog colours.
immersivevfx.menu.about.naturalFoliageCo: Softer, more natural colours for grass and leaves.
immersivevfx.menu.about.skyMode: Realistic draws a computed sky. Vanilla keeps the familiar colours.
immersivevfx.menu.about.customSkies: Replaces the sky with the ImmersiveVFX sky, sun and moon.
immersivevfx.menu.about.shootingStars: Stars streak across the night sky now and then.
immersivevfx.menu.about.cloudRendering: How clouds are drawn, or turn them off.
immersivevfx.menu.about.cloudFormation: The shape of the cloud layer.
immersivevfx.menu.about.fogRenderingMode: Immersive uses biome fog. Chunk Distance follows your render distance. Off leaves fog alone.
immersivevfx.menu.about.atmosphericFog: A soft haze that thickens with distance and height.
immersivevfx.menu.about.lowLyingFog: Fog banks that hug the ground.
immersivevfx.menu.about.groundMist: Wisps of mist drifting over the ground.
immersivevfx.menu.about.weatherMist: Extra mist while it rains or snows.
immersivevfx.menu.about.bloom: Light sources get a soft halo in the colour of their light.
immersivevfx.menu.about.enhancedLight: Glowing blocks look hotter and their dark parts turn darker.
immersivevfx.menu.about.coloredLight: Light takes on the color of the block it comes from. The color is read from the block texture, so modded lights work too.
immersivevfx.menu.about.dungeonsFire: Fire gets lit smoke, embers, burn marks and warm light.
immersivevfx.menu.about.lightRays: Rays of sunlight falling through the air.
immersivevfx.menu.about.underwaterLightR: Shafts of light while you are under water.
immersivevfx.menu.about.shadows: The sun and the moon cast real shadows.
immersivevfx.menu.about.shadowMode: Enhanced also changes how the world is lit. Normal only adds shadows.
immersivevfx.menu.about.shadowResolution: Sharper shadows at long shadow distance. Medium doubles the resolution, High doubles it again. High needs a lot of video memory.
immersivevfx.menu.about.shadowBoost: Makes shadows darker on top of Shadow Strength, up to twice as dark at 100%. Works above and under water in every shadow mode.
immersivevfx.menu.about.shadowDistance: How far away shadows are still drawn.
immersivevfx.menu.about.mobShadows: Mobs and players cast shadows too.
immersivevfx.menu.about.depthCalculation: Draws leaves and plants into the depth buffer first, so their shadows and lighting are calculated only once per visible pixel. Faster in dense forests. Works only with Sodium and Shadow Mode Enhanced. May cause flickering with connected textures.
immersivevfx.menu.about.waterReflections: Water mirrors the world and the sky.
immersivevfx.menu.about.iceReflections: Ice mirrors the world and the sky.
immersivevfx.menu.about.reflectionQualit: Higher quality finds finer detail and costs more performance.
immersivevfx.menu.about.waterColorMappin: Water colour follows the biome and fades with depth.
immersivevfx.menu.about.shoreFoam: Foam along the edges of water.
immersivevfx.menu.about.lavaFoam: Glowing crust along the edges of lava.
immersivevfx.menu.about.waterfallMist: Falling water runs white, foams where it lands and throws up mist. The higher the fall, the stronger it gets.
immersivevfx.menu.about.waterLeaves: Leaves float on water near trees.
immersivevfx.menu.about.underwaterCausti: Rippling light on the ground under water.
immersivevfx.menu.about.snowAndSandParti: The look of snow and sand particles.
immersivevfx.menu.about.specks: Tiny specks of dust in the air.
immersivevfx.menu.about.pollenAndSpores: Pollen over flowers and spores in forests and caves.
immersivevfx.menu.about.windGusts: Streaks of wind passing through the air.
immersivevfx.menu.about.weatherVisuals: The look of rain, snow and storms.
immersivevfx.menu.about.sandStorm: Sand storms in deserts during rain.
immersivevfx.menu.about.auroraBorealis: Northern lights in cold biomes at night.
immersivevfx.menu.about.meteorShower: Showers of meteors on some nights.
immersivevfx.menu.about.fireworks: Fireworks in the distance on some nights.
immersivevfx.menu.about.blockOutlines: A dark contour along the edges of blocks.
immersivevfx.menu.about.blockOutlineThic: How wide the block contour is.
immersivevfx.menu.about.mobOutlines: A dark contour around mobs and players.
immersivevfx.menu.about.mobOutlineThickn: How wide the mob contour is.
immersivevfx.menu.about.enchantmentOutli: Enchanted items in your hands get a glowing contour.
immersivevfx.menu.about.dynamicItemOutli: The contour takes its colour from the item.
immersivevfx.menu.about.enchantmentOutli: Shifts the colour of the contour.
immersivevfx.menu.about.endColorGrading: Tints the picture in the End.
immersivevfx.menu.about.endAura: A glowing aura over the End sky.
immersivevfx.menu.about.movingGrass: Grass and tall grass sway in the wind.
immersivevfx.menu.about.movingPlants: Flowers, ferns, saplings, crops and other plants sway gently in the wind.
immersivevfx.menu.about.movingLeaves: Tree leaves move softly in the wind.
immersivevfx.menu.about.atmosphericFogSt: Higher values bring the fog closer and make it thicker. 0% turns it off.
immersivevfx.menu.page.vegetation.desc: Grass, plants and leaves that move with the wind.
immersivevfx.menu.about.dynamicFog: The haze takes on the color and thickness of each biome.
immersivevfx.menu.about.multiCloudLayers: Adds a second cloud layer about 30 blocks above the first.
immersivevfx.menu.about.doubleClouds: Clouds get a smaller second tier on top.
immersivevfx.menu.about.underwaterShadow: Plants and blocks cast shadows on the sea floor while you are under water.
immersivevfx.menu.about.waterColors: IVFX Vanilla keeps the classic water colors. IVFX Realistic uses deeper, more natural colors and lighting under water.
immersivevfx.menu.about.dynamicColorGrad: The world takes on a slight blue tone at night. Torches, lava and other warm light stay warm, and it fades out underground.
immersivevfx.menu.about.terrainGlint: All blocks and the water surface catch the sun while you are above water.
immersivevfx.menu.about.glintSmoothness: 0% gives sharp sparkling pixels. 100% gives a soft, gentle sheen.
immersivevfx.menu.about.underwaterGlint: All blocks catch the sun while you are under water.
immersivevfx.menu.about.underwaterDepthB: Things far away under water look soft and blurred.
immersivevfx.menu.page.colorGrading.desc: Your own color look for the whole game, optionally per time of day.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gradingMode: IVFX Vanilla uses one grading for the whole day. IVFX Enhanced has its own grading for dawn, midday, dusk and night and blends between them with the sun. Runs inside an existing screen pass.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gradingEditTime: Chooses which time of day the sliders below change. Dimensions without a day cycle use Midday.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gradingExposure: Brightens or darkens the whole image. 100 % is one stop brighter.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gradingContrast: Pushes dark and bright parts apart or pulls them together. 100 % is unchanged.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gradingShadows: Lifts or deepens the darkest parts of the image.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gradingMidtones: Brightens or darkens the middle tones, like a gamma curve.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gradingHighlight: Raises or lowers the brightest parts of the image.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gradingSaturatio: Strength of all colors. 0 % is black and white, 100 % is unchanged.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gradingVibrance: Boosts weak colors more than strong ones, so bright colors do not glow.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gradingHueShift: Turns all colors around the color wheel.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gradingTemperatu: Warmer, orange light with positive values, cooler, blue light with negative values.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gradingTint: Shifts the image towards magenta with positive values and towards green with negative values.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gradingRedStreng: Saturation of red and orange tones only.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gradingGreenStre: Saturation of green tones only, for example grass and leaves.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gradingBlueStren: Saturation of blue tones only, for example sky and water.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gradingRedHue: Moves red tones towards orange with positive values and towards pink with negative values.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gradingGreenHue: Moves green tones towards yellow and olive with negative values and towards cyan with positive values.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gradingBlueHue: Moves blue tones towards purple with positive values and towards cyan with negative values.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gradingPreset: IVFX Vanilla resets every grading slider. Medieval gives muted, warm colors with olive greens, Vintage gives soft, faded colors. Both turn the grading on if it is off. A preset fills the sliders of every time of day. Changing a slider afterwards shows Custom.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gpuGrass: Adds small pixel art grass tufts on top of grass blocks near you. They take the biome color, react to light and shadows and sway when Moving Grass is on. They cast no shadows and are purely visual.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gpuGrassDensity: How many tufts grow on each grass block.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gpuGrassHeight: Size of the tufts. 100 % matches the pixel size of vanilla blocks.
immersivevfx.menu.about.gpuGrassDistance: How far around you the tufts appear. They shrink away towards the end of this distance.
